sentences.japanese: 子供の頃は、周りのものが何でも大きく見えるものだ。
sentences.english: When we are small, everything seems so big.

sentences.japanese: 周りを見てごらんなさい。
間取りも狭いし、周りもうるさいけど、住めば都なんだよ、この部屋。
sentences.english: It's a small noisy apartment, but it's where I live and I call it home.

sentences.japanese: 周りに濃霧が立ちこめていた。
sentences.english: There was a thick fog around.
